# telnyx_enterprise_reputation_remediation_submit (Action)

Asks Telnyx to remediate the reputation of some of an enterprise's numbers, for example ones flagged as spam.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `call_purpose` (String) How the numbers are used (free text).
- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.
- `phone_numbers` (List of String) Phone numbers in E.164 format. Each must belong to this enterprise. Maximum 2,000 per request.

### Optional

- `contact_email` (String) Optional contact email for this remediation request.
- `webhook_url` (String) Optional https:// URL for status notifications.
